description: Read one of your Besidka chats: title, project, whether it is pinned or excluded from memory, its share settings if it has a live share (the share link itself only when the connection can also change chats, chats:write), the models used, a context summary (counts of outputs, inputs, web sources, generated images, research reports and memory actions, plus up to 20 attached files by id and name) and the text of its messages, oldest to newest. Long messages and long chats are truncated; file contents, images and tool output are left out. Requires signing in (chats:read).

maxMessages.description: Newest messages to return, 1 to 200. Defaults to 50

name: get_chat
title: Read a chat
